journal_lines: Tracked quarry into the tunnels. The miner knew the passages. The hunter knew when to wait.
Prey went underground. Followed. The dark was less of a problem with two sets of instincts.
Cave hunt. The miner lit the way. The hunter finished it.
The tunnels gave the hunter cover. The caves gave the miner purpose. Both worked.
Quarry drove into the shaft. The miner cut off the exit. The hunter waited.
A day of two skills in one place. Both justified the trip.
The prey went to ground and the ground was full of ore. Good problem.
Hunting in cave systems is not the plan. It worked out.
Chased the quarry down through the levels. Found ore on the way. Found the quarry at the bottom.
The mine became a hunting ground. Both uses exhausted.
Underground pursuit. The miner knew where the tunnels ended. Useful.
Prey and stone, same passage. Different tools. Both productive.
